Name: Adoptable Wolf Pet (Content Patcher)
Author: Emfen1
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Adds another choice of pet: the wolf! This is not a replacement mod, so all vanilla pets are still available alongside this new addition. Simply unzip the file into the mods folder and your new wolf will be ready for adoption![/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Custom sprites for all animations, drawn by yours truly.[/*]
[*]New sound effect: Wolf's bark is replaced with a howl (other dogs not affected).[/*]
[*]Bark sprite replaced with a howl sprite (adorable).[/*]
[*]Wolf is larger than the other dogs.[/*]
[/list][b]Note: If not chosen at start, the Wolf costs 40,000 gold, just like the other pets.[/b]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22631?tab=description]Hats on Pets Plus[/url] recommended.

[b][size=4]Credits & Permissions[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Credit to ConcernedApe for the original dog sprite sheet (dog1) used as a guide.[/*]
[*]Howl sound effect is from freesound_community on [url=https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/nature-dog-howling-78278/]Pixabay[/url].[/*]
[*]Please do not re-upload this mod to other websites without my permission. Only download from the original Nexus page.[/*]
[/list]

Downloads.Description:
Adds another "pet preference" option to Stardew Valley: a wolf! Available at character creation or from Marnie's shop.

(Hats on Pets Plus strongly recommended, or else the hat positioning will not line up. However it is not required to run the mod.)
